name: abendrot
title: Abendrot
description: Control the Abendrot screen-warmth app: read status, set warmth, toggle warming, and reveal true color.
author: mlazzarotto

commands.name: status
commands.title: Abendrot Status
commands.subtitle: Abendrot
commands.description: Show live Abendrot state: warmth, schedule, displays, and excluded apps

commands.name: set-warmth
commands.title: Set Warmth
commands.subtitle: Abendrot
commands.description: Set global warmth as a strength (0.0-1.0) or a Kelvin target (500-6500)

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Warming
commands.subtitle: Abendrot
commands.description: Switch Abendrot warming on or off based on the current state

commands.name: reveal
commands.title: Reveal True Color
commands.subtitle: Abendrot
commands.description: Momentary true-color peek that drops warmth for a few seconds, then eases back

commands.name: toggle-cozy
commands.title: Toggle Cozy Mode
commands.subtitle: Abendrot
commands.description: Switch Abendrot cozy mode (expanded warmth) on or off

commands.name: quit-app
commands.title: Quit Abendrot
commands.subtitle: Abendrot
commands.description: Quit the Abendrot menu-bar app gracefully
